definition: A patient-owned private health memory containing identity context, original health records, longitudinal events and separately labelled derived knowledge.

source_foundation.purpose: Preserve identity, birth context, medical records, reports, media references and observations with source and version.
rules: Original content is immutable after append.
Correction creates a new version and preserves the old version.
Media is represented by an opaque storage reference and content hash, never a public URL.
Every entry carries source type, source reference, occurred_at, creator and audit event.

health_timeline.purpose: Organize patient change through time without collapsing provenance.
rules: Every event references an original entry in the same patient vault.
Patient statements, doctor confirmations, external documents and device records remain distinguishable.
Timeline order does not imply causation.

derived_knowledge.purpose: Store summaries, trends, reminders, questions and learning notes without turning them into original facts.
rules: Every derived item cites one or more source entries from the same vault.
AI-authored content always starts as ai_draft.
Derived knowledge has clinical_authority=false even when reviewed.
A new interpretation supersedes rather than deletes the previous version.

agent_access.patient_tutor: May retrieve only the vault whose patient_subject_code equals the agent node owner, subject to purpose and provider controls.
agent_access.physician_apprentice: Has no permanent or default patient-vault access; may read one current patient through MAP-AI-003 session-scoped ephemeral access.
agent_access.commons_export: Denied by default; requires separate consent, de-identification and contribution workflow.

global_invariants: The patient is the owner and rights subject of the private vault.
Patient identity and original health records are part of the patient knowledge base, not external attachments without provenance.
Clinical records and source media are not copied into the common health knowledge body by default.
The patient tutor is a controlled reader and derived-knowledge author, not the owner of the vault.
Physician consultation access is temporary, patient-specific and never copies raw patient content into physician permanent knowledge.
No AI output becomes a doctor diagnosis, prescription or signed record.
Gate 0 uses SYN- subjects and synthetic:// sources only.
production_gates: encryption at rest and in transit with approved KMS
encrypted object storage for reports, images, video and audio
backup, recovery, retention and deletion policy
provider routing decision before private data is sent to any model
legal, privacy, clinical and human technical partner approval
